{
  "name": "@paulirish/chromestatus",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "type": "module",
  "packageManager": "pnpm@10.30.3",
  "description": "Modern, idiomatic client interface for ChromeStatus feature data",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+https://github.com/paulirish/chromestatus.git"
  },
  "files": [
    "src/",
    "data/basic.json",
    "data/web-feature-extras.json",
    "data/features/"
  ],
  "exports": {
    ".": "./src/index.ts",
    "./data/*": "./data/*"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=24.11.0"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "audit:mappings": "node scripts/print-mappings.ts",
    "audit:gated": "node scripts/print-gated-features.ts",
    "audit:conformance": "node scripts/audit-bcd-conformance.ts",
    "audit:overrides": "node scripts/audit-overrides.ts",
    "audit:chromestatus-edits": "node scripts/print-chromestatus-edits.ts",
    "compile": "node build/compile-data.ts",
    "download": "node build/download-raw.ts",
    "fetch": "pnpm run download && pnpm run compile",
    "preflight": "pnpm test",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "test": "pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:node",
    "test:node": "node --test test/**/*.test.ts",
    "submodules:update": "git submodule update --init --recursive",
    "submodules:upgrade": "git submodule update --init --recursive --remote"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/node": "^26.2.0",
    "web-features": "^3.40.1"
  }
}

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  basics:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      # Compile reads web-features-mappings; the other submodules are only for local audits.
      - name: Checkout web-features-mappings submodule
        run: git submodule update --init --depth 1 submodules/web-features-mappings

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v5

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6.3.0
        with:
          node-version: 24

      - name: Install
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Compile data snapshot
        run: pnpm run fetch

      - name: Preflight (Typecheck, Lint, Tests)
        env:
          TEST_REPORTER: spec
        run: pnpm run preflight

name: Publish Package

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  id-token: write # Required for OIDC provenance authentication
  contents: read  # Required for checkout

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      # Compile reads web-features-mappings; the other submodules are only for local audits.
      - name: Checkout web-features-mappings submodule
        run: git submodule update --init --depth 1 submodules/web-features-mappings

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v5

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6.3.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Compile data snapshot
        run: pnpm run fetch

      - name: Preflight check
        run: pnpm run preflight

      - name: Publish to npm
        run: |
          npm install -g npm@latest
          npm publish --provenance --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/

name: Test

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  shellcheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    # I tried 4 of the top shellcheck actions. They all kinda suck. Not providing much output, not letting me run it on all files, etc. On this one for now, but happy to change it later.
    - uses: Azbagheri/shell-linter@latest
      with:
        severity: error
        path: ".exports,.functions,.macos,.aliases,.bash_prompt,.bash_profile,.bashrc"

    - name: Fish - install fish shell
      uses: fish-shop/install-fish-shell@v1
    - name: Fish - syntax check
      uses: fish-shop/syntax-check@v2

name: Publish to npm

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*' # Trigger on version tags (e.g., v3.0.0)

permissions:
  id-token: write # Required for OIDC
  contents: read  # Required for checkout

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      with:
        version: latest

    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: lts/* # 22.14.0 is required for Trusted Publishing
        registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'
        cache: 'pnpm'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: pnpm install

    - name: Run Typecheck
      run: pnpm run typecheck

    - name: Run Tests
      run: pnpm test

    - name: Publish to npm
      run: |
        npm publish --provenance --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/

name: Test Suite

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master ]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      with:
        version: latest

    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        cache: 'pnpm'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: pnpm install

    - name: Run Typecheck
      run: pnpm run typecheck

    - name: Run Tests
      run: pnpm test

name: Publish to npm

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10.22.0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22.14.0 # Minimum for Trusted Publishing
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm exec playwright install

      - run: pnpm test

      - name: Publish to npm
        run: |
          npm install -g npm@latest
          npm publish --provenance --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/

name: Publish to npm
on:
  workflow_dispatch: # Allow manual triggering
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      id-token: write # Required for OIDC
      contents: read  # Required for checkout
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22.14.0
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'

      - name: Publish to npm
        run: |
          npm install -g npm@latest
          npm publish --provenance --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request: # run on all PRs, not just PRs to a particular branch

jobs:
  basics:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: git clone
      uses: actions/checkout@v3
      with:
        fetch-depth: 100

    - uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: latest

    - run: npm ci

    - name: Setup BATS
      uses: mig4/setup-bats@v1
      with:
        bats-version: 0.4.0  # This is the version i have locally. looks like an upgrade is in order, though…
    - run: git submodule update --init
      name: pull in bats assertion libs

    - run: npm run lint
    - run: npm run shellcheck
    - run: npm run unit

name: CI

on:
  push:
    # branches: [master]
  pull_request: # run on all PRs, not just PRs to a particular branch

jobs:
  basics:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node: ['12', '14', '16', '17']
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: node ${{ matrix.node }}
    env:
      LATEST_NODE: '17'

    steps:
    - name: git clone
      uses: actions/checkout@v2
      with:
        fetch-depth: 100

    - name: Use Node.js ${{ matrix.node }}
      uses: actions/setup-node@v1
      with:
        node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}

    - run: yarn install-all:ci
    - run: yarn test

name: Build project and Run Lighthouse CI
on: [push]
jobs:
  lhci:
    name: Lighthouse CI
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: 16
      - name: npm install, build
        run: |
          npm install
      - name: run Lighthouse CI
        run: |
          npm install -g @lhci/cli@0.12.x
          lhci autorun --collect.staticDistDir=./variants --upload.target=temporary-public-storage
        env:
          LHCI_GITHUB_APP_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.LHCI_GITHUB_APP_TOKEN }}
